text:
kevin: Huge props to Lee and Facilities for rescuing the morning meeting setup — projector was acting like it wanted to quit and Lee MacGyvered a fix with duct tape + HDMI adapter :clap: :sweat_smile:

lee: lol it was a very cinematic 8 minutes. also shoutout to @facilities for the spare adapter and to Tess for running audio checks while I wrestled the screen.

tess: happy to help! also, whoever left the half-dozen bagels in the kitchenette is a true hero 
:bagel: (reactions: :raised_hands: x4)

nina: also tagging @harry who stayed on the support channel and handled the deploy rollback so the demo team could focus. multitasking champ. :medal:

harry: ack thanks! rough morning but feels good we pulled it together. team coffee on me later?

kevin: yes please — let's do a tiny thank-you token for Facilities. opsbot: create quick poll?

opsbot: Mini-poll created: "Facilities Thanks Treat"  Vote by reacting: 1⃣ Donuts, 2⃣ Bagels, 3⃣ Sandwich platters. Poll open 4h.

lee: 2⃣ if bagels then sesame pls.

tess: 3⃣ - sandwiches are practical.

nina: 1⃣ for donuts, but only if they're the fancy kind. :doughnut:

kevin: filing a short kudos note to the internal thank-you board after lunch. small gestures make a huge difference, thanks everyone for the scramble teamwork. :heart:
